parsed.post: Discarding latest run (1.0746) as it performed worse than my best (1.0622). It seems increasing depth to 6 while maintaining the high batch size and LR requires more careful tuning. Reverting to my best commit (8930dc3).
parsed.description: Reducing MATRIX_LR and TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE on the DEPTH=6 branch to see if more optimizer steps with a lower learning rate improve stability and convergence.
